title: Landos Experimental Additions
description: A experimentation zone adding various blocks, items and other stuff to the game as I learn to code mods from scratch.
body:
This mod has no specific purpose, it adds various things as I learn to make them and experiment around with them.

As of now, I have added the beginning of a new type of wood, and steel. Along with that I have added 3 variants of a new ore with the aim to eventually turn them into a modification system akin to enchanting!

The mod includes a varying array of blocks, items and tools (Eventually) which I add to it while learning to mod Minecraft. The mod is free to use anywhere and anyhow. It will be updated as a tribute to my learning progress as often as I try stuff out until I eventually find I have learned all that I could or want to.
